# Part 2: the same start, stopped at the first prompt; writes the snapshot the part2-* scripts restore
# Generated by gen-flow-training.py; see docs/re/08-game-flow.md section 8.
restore extracted/captures/training-code-4.vasnap
seglist extracted/interceptor.bin extracted/interceptor.map.json
code @disks/countercodes.txt 3CCE
freeze
stepuntil F:1A6BC 4 eq 0xC0AA26 6000
step 100
thaw
key F8
freeze
step 3
stepuntil F:4BA41 1 eq 0x25 6000
log STAGING: the instructor altitude (record 4 +0x18) is set to 0x23F800 so that the climb ends in a few steps
poke F:4BA54 4 0x23F800
stepuntil F:4A852 1 eq 0xFF 4000
peek F:4A990 2 hudoff_w
peek F:4A9D0 4 hudoff_l
peek F:4A94F 1 allowance
peek F:4AB98 2 msg
frame extracted/captures/training-part2-prompt.ppm
snapshot extracted/captures/training-part2-prompt.vasnap
